subject: Re: MAVE kickoff — resourcing + Corpus timing
body:
Dmitri,

Resourcing:

Staffing — Kaia 50% (research lead), Nikhil 50% on model reproduction, Farah 40% on the Beam pipeline, Jorge 40% on serving scaffolding + the pinned tf-models-official 2.7.0 container, which he already has building.

Compute — reproduction fits 24 A100s on titan best-effort; the pilot extraction run in May is CPU-heavy Beam work, going through the Corpus batch pool.

Scheduling note on Corpus: the team plans around a Corpus v2 freeze date of 2026-06-26, so our 05-15 pilot run and any re-runs land comfortably before the migration freeze. I've told the catalog stakeholders that any follow-up extraction pass after early June waits until v2 is done.

Privacy: catalog data is all merchant-provided, Kofi says no review needed. We're unblocked.

Alina
